transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I suppose I'm here because... things have just gone very quiet lately. 

I mean, the part of me that used to reach out to people, or take pleasure in things... it's just not really there right now. I used to enjoy my work, and... yoga, galleries, even just journaling. But lately... I don't know, I'm mostly just moving through my obligations.
Has this low mood been present more days than not for at least two years?
I'm not really sure. I haven't... I don't really keep track of it like that. It's just been a while, I guess.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two months when your mood was back to normal?
Um... I'm not sure. I haven't really noticed a break like that. It just sort of... stays the same.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I don't... I wouldn't really use the word depressed. It's not like a deep sadness or crying all day or anything like that. It's just... flat. So, no, I don't think so.
During any period in the past, did you have at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I... I think you just asked me that. Um... no. Like I said, it's not really depression. I just don't feel much of anything.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized, euphoric, or irritable for several days or more?
No... I haven't. I don't really get like that.
Have your symptoms ever gotten clearly worse for at least two weeks compared with your usual baseline?
Um... no, not really. I haven't noticed anything like that. It's just... pretty much the same most of the time.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Um... I think you just asked me about that a minute ago. Still no. I don't really get down or sad like that.
